description: Plan multi-shot AI videos with a coherent visual theme, shot-by-shot prompts, audio direction, and post-production checklist.

defaultPrompt: Help me plan a multi-shot AI video using the AI Video Storyboard workflow.
Turn this video brief into a consistent shot list with copy-ready prompts and audio direction.

interface.longDescription: Turns a video brief into a coordinated multi-shot storyboard with a shared visual theme, concrete copy-ready prompts, per-shot audio direction, narrative rationale, and a post-production checklist. Focuses on planning; it does not generate or edit video files.

name: ai-video-storyboard
